## Summary

Describe the problem and the approach used to solve it.

## Validation

- [ ] Hardware-independent tests pass.
- [ ] Documentation and configuration examples were updated when behavior changed.
- [ ] No credentials, private addresses, room-identifying media, personal paths, logs, or generated builds were added.
- [ ] Navigation or command changes were first tested without robot motion where possible.
- [ ] Hardware testing performed, or the reason it was not possible is documented below.

## Hardware and deployment impact

Describe affected ROS distributions, Go2/Pi/laptop components, topics, ports, deployment steps, and rollback considerations. Write `None` when the change is hardware-independent.
